definitions.control: Same executable per-point Camera preparation versus immutable prepared-camera projection. Exact source, all selected vertices, transformations, clipping, frame cache/margin, request batching, worker/commit/render/RDP policies held fixed
definitions.selection: Sum of all four pane selection-frame rebuild calculations in the request transition; common diagnostic serialization overhead excluded from this calculation timer
definitions.transition: Complete callback gap crossing selection/Boolean request/UI redraw
definitions.fps: Distinct encoded Perspective frames during steady before/after pointer navigation; not UI callback or RDP client video FPS
definitions.samples: Two alternating A/B pairs per profile/size; descriptive medians and worst values, no statistical significance claim
